items.title: Show HN: Uruky (EU-based Kagi alternative) now has Image Search and URL Rewrites
items.author: BrunoBernardino
items.rawContent:
You can get a 2h free trial by solving a proof-of-work captcha when topping up your account for the first time.

If you'd like to learn more, an independent interview was posted a couple of weeks ago [1], and the FAQ [2] has a lot of information as well.

For the source code sharing, we've talked with lawyers and are inclined to no longer require the NDA/NCC for privacy reasons shared with us before (signing requires identification), but instead use a source-available permissive
items.summary: Uruky 是一款总部位于欧盟的新型搜索引擎，作为 Kagi 的替代品，新上线了图像搜索和 URL 重写功能，并提供通过算力验证码获取的 2 小时免费试用。其源代码策略转向更宽松的“源码可用”（source-available）模式，不再强制要求签署含身份验证的 NDA/NCC 协议。
items.summaryEn: Uruky is an EU-based search engine alternative to Kagi that has recently launched image search and URL rewriting features, offering a 2-hour free trial via proof-of-work captcha. It has shifted its source code policy to a permissive source-available model, dropping mandatory NDA/NCC agreements requiring user identification.
items.titleEn: Show HN: Uruky (EU-based Kagi alternative) now has Image Search and URL Rewrites

items.title: I Did the Math on GitHub Copilot's New AI Credits Billing. The 24x Price Gap Changes Everything.
items.author: tokenmixai
items.rawContent: GitHub Copilot switched from Premium Request Units to usage-based AI Credits on June 1, 2026. I ran the numbers across 10 models and 5 real workflows. The same agent run costs $0.0068 or $1.85 depending on which model you pick. Here's what actually changes — and what doesn't.
items.summary: 本文分析了GitHub Copilot自2026年6月1日起启用的AI积分计费模式，通过对比10种模型在5类真实工作流中的成本，揭示了最高达24倍的价格差异及其对开发者实际使用的影响。
items.summaryEn: This article analyzes GitHub Copilot’s new AI Credits billing model introduced on June 1, 2026, revealing up to a 24× price gap across 10 models and 5 real-world workflows—highlighting concrete cost implications for developers.
items.titleEn: I Did the Math on GitHub Copilot's New AI Credits Billing. The 24x Price Gap Changes Everything.
